title: C^1 cutoff sequence phi_k = 1 on (-infinity, 1], = 0 on [1 + eps_k, infinity), eps_k -> 0 (parent step 4)
statement: Let delta > 0 be a real number (the Lean binder ε₁). Then there exist functions phi_k : R -> R and real numbers eps_k, indexed by k in N = {0, 1, 2, ...}, such that: (1) 0 < eps_k <= delta for every k; (2) eps_k -> 0 as k -> infinity; (3) every phi_k is C^1; (4) every phi_k is nonincreasing (antitone); (5) 0 <= phi_k(s) <= 1 for all k and all real s; (6) phi_k(s) = 1 for all k whenever s <= 1; (7) phi_k(s) = 0 whenever s >= 1 + eps_k; (8) for every real s > 1, phi_k(s) = 0 for all sufficiently large k.
lean_statement: ∀ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < ε k ∧ ε k ≤ ε₁) ∧ Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, Antitone (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k s, 0 ≤ φ k s ∧ φ k s ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k s, s ≤ 1 → φ k s = 1) ∧ (∀ k s, 1 + ε k ≤ s → φ k s = 0) ∧ (∀ s, 1 < s → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, φ k s = 0)
